odc_type: incorrect scope modeling for function expressions
observation_summary: The compiler fails to rename local variables that shadow function names, resulting in incorrect output where the function name is incorrectly referenced instead of the local variable.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the compiler's scope modeling failed to correctly handle variable shadowing within function expressions. Specifically, when a function expression has a name that is also declared as a local variable within the function body, the compiler failed to treat the local variable as shadowing the function name. This led to incorrect variable renaming during optimization. The fix involved restructuring how the compiler tracks scopes by explicitly handling the parameter list (LP node) and function body as a single scope, ensuring that local declarations are correctly registered and shadowed within that scope.
